declared_extras.binding: eight-field match: six declared features plus both extras

expected_source: the frozen independent evaluator, tools/round-42/indep-eval-v4.py @ freeze, envelopes @ rev

fixtures.binding: tools/round-42/fixtures.json is the manifest's declared pin file, every pinned fixture's committed copy is present at the freeze with the pinned sha256, and the pinned license is MIT

fixtures.damage_recipe: pinned 4-byte zero window at damage_offset; pre-verified with sasquatch 4.5.1 + REA 6.5.0, never probed at run time
fixtures.resolution: committed copy under --fixtures-dir, else the cache under --scratch, else the pinned URL with --fetch; each candidate is sha256-checked

tuple_check.rule: R42-CL1 (QUALITY 85): a declared feature tuple is written into the manifest only after this generator MEASURED the same six fields in the envelope its own --run produced for that carrier (observed_features, over the artifact on disk) and found them EQUAL; on any difference it writes NO manifest and exits 3 (declared_tuple_unobserved).

writer.block_encoder: gzip=zlib level 9, comp_id 1; xz=.xz container/CRC32, comp_id 4 (replaces stock raw-LZMA2 and comp_id 2)
writer.name: gen-squashfs.py

generator_tuple_check.cross_check_binding: the recorded observed tuple equals the counter's own extraction from the envelope; the recorded declared tuple equals the carrier declared_features

legacy_chunks.binding: no v1-v3 envelope is no-squashfs-chunk on either side, and the row handler cell is `none`

lookup_7b.note: A1: scored and reported; CTL-C2-7b is never bound

runjson.binding: run.json subject_sha256 == carrier sha256, digest_matches_carrier true, and the record's own summary == the counter's extraction from the envelope
